answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the nectar of a task receipt, and the ferrous is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. What survives to the zephyr is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
